label: TP
reason: User input from query string flows through doSomething() where the ternary condition (7*42)-106>200 evaluates to false, causing param to be assigned to bar. Bar is then concatenated directly into SQL query without proper escaping, creating a genuine cross-site scripting and SQL injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: ternary condition evaluates to false, assigning user param to bar
SQL query concatenates bar (user input) directly without sanitization
